Speaker1: When you compare the fate of athletes living off allowances and pensions in less popular sports like triathlon to those making crazy salaries, it makes me think our associations really need to reflect and consider some reforms.
Speaker1: If you think about it, the best example is definitely Jang Mi-ran; weightlifting was super unpopular until she came along and made it recognized and popular in Korea, even if it happened really fast. So, looking at that, our associations need to change a lot too.
